programs.description: Bindu's life is in danger when she witnesses two thieves steal the idol of a deity from a temple. However, Manikandan, her elephant, protects her from harm.
Vivek, a gifted singer and dancer, develops a liking towards Doctor Rajagopal's sister. In order to court her, he makes his sister and brother-in-law rent a house opposite to Rajagopal's home.
Balu is forced to follow the family profession of fortune-telling against his dream of becoming a film actor. His life changes when some of his predictions come true and he becomes famous.

A vengeful son's search for his estranged father leads to unexpected complications when he finds himself growing close to a government contractor.
Lalu's circumstances begin to change when he is inducted by a gangster. However, when his recruiter murders his friend and casts his life into disarray, he sets out for revenge.
A primary school teacher is obsessed with the world of cinema and dreams of becoming an actor one day. However, his blind obsession eventually leads him into a precarious situation.
Appukuttan and Gauri meet during a village festival. After some constant fights, they fall in love but her brother, Shivan Kutty, has a different plan for her.
